body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> IOPS presented its new 9mm-thick mp3 player ''X11'' during 2007, which is encased with simple hairlined aluminum steel.
It supports 262k 1.3-inch TFT-LCD, audio/video playback( MP3, WMA, OGG, AVI, MPEG4, and Divx), image/text viewer, FM radio tuner, USB 2.0, and five different kinds of EQ.
